SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat.en: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!

SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro.en: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!
SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro.fr: Petit insolent !\nComment tu oses entrer ainsi !

SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle.en: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!
